YouTube Setup
Step 1 — Get an API key (free, takes ~2 min):
1. Open Google Cloud Console and sign in with your Google account.
2. Create a new project (name it anything, e.g. "Creator Stats").
3. Click Enable APIs & Services → search YouTube Data API v3 → click Enable.
4. Go to Credentials (left sidebar) → Create Credentials → API Key.
5. Copy the key that appears and paste it below.

Step 2 — Find your Channel ID:
Open YouTube Studio — look at the URL in your browser. It will contain /channel/UCxxxxxxx. The part starting with UC… is your Channel ID.
Twitch Setup
1. Open dev.twitch.tv/console → Register Your Application
  • Name: Creator Stats (any name works)
  • OAuth Redirect URL: http://localhost:7734/callback
  • Category: Analytics Tool
  • Client Type: Confidential
2. Click Create, then click New Secret to generate a Client Secret.
3. Copy both the Client ID and Client Secret below.
